audit.why: Both layers already read Heimerdinger x4 / Illaoi at 6 / Heimerdinger x2, matching the packet chart and the 46.27% win rate over 402 games. The whys agree with the enums row for row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single Illaoi spike on this page — level 6 — was built on a mechanic that does not exist: 'R Leap of Faith clears the turret line', 'vaults the turret line and lands you on him', 'jump the turret wall onto him'.
audit.why: Leap of Faith is a 450-range self-cast that damages nearby enemies and spawns a tentacle per champion hit. It does not move Illaoi at all. Her only leap is Harsh Lesson (W), 400 range, onto a target, flat 4s. A player following this page would press R expecting to cross the turret nest and die standing still.
audit.corrected: spikes[0], spikes[1], mid, whys[4] and wants.you[0] rebuilt around what actually reaches him: Test of Spirit at 900 range, Harsh Lesson's 4s leap onto that target, and R as the tentacle-spawner once he is in range.

audit.whatIsWrong: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade was described only as 'his self-peel stun, dodge it' with no cooldown and no mention of the direct-hit condition.
audit.why: Riot's text: it stuns anyone DIRECTLY hit and only slows surrounding units. It is a flat 11s at every rank. That distinction is the whole engage window — a grazing grenade does not stop you.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t now state the flat 11s and the direct-hit requirement, alongside Micro-Rockets' 11s / 1325 range and Harsh Lesson's flat 4s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged zero cooldown-sequencing cues; no number appeared anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Concrete windows make the advice usable.
audit.corrected: Grenade 11s, Micro-Rockets 11s, Harsh Lesson 4s, Leap of Faith 120s written into the cooldown block.

notes: PRIORITY: this page's only Illaoi win condition was a fabricated mechanic. Five fields told the player that Leap of Faith clears, vaults or jumps the turret wall onto Heimerdinger. Leap of Faith is a 450-range self-cast that does not move her; her only leap is Harsh Lesson (W), 400 range, onto a target. A player pressing R at the turret line to cross it loses a 120s ultimate and the fight. Rebuilt around Test of Spirit's 900 range as the actual reach. Second fix: the grenade stuns only on a DIRECT hit — a graze just slows, which changes when it is safe to walk in.
